title: Yellow Silky Middle Eastern Beetroot Maqluba
description: A kid-friendly Middle Eastern dish featuring beetroot, this maqluba is peppery, silky, and paleo-friendly, made with dry brine and delicious spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the beetroot and cauliflower with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the beetroot and cauliflower mixture in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until they are softened.
Add the cumin, coriander, and paprika to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
In a large serving dish, create a layer of the roasted beetroot and cauliflower mixture.
Add a layer of the onion and spice mixture on top of the beetroot layer.
Repeat the layers until all the ingredients are used, ending with a layer of beetroot on top.
Cover the dish with a lid and simmer over low heat for 10 minutes.
Remove the lid and let the maqluba rest for 5 minutes before serving.
